answer: The summit counter is kept in ocean and sable publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 12 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 12 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3217 identities would post 3093 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
